name: Kinpurse
summary: A family money app with a card for each person, pocket money, chores and savings goals
about: A seven-page money app for a whole family sharing one account, in bright candy colours or a plum night theme. Every person has their own card that you can freeze, limit and control by category, and pocket money flies from the family pot to a kid's card as a stream of coins. Chores pay out when a parent approves them, and kids save towards goals that parents can match.
how: Open a page from the tile sidebar (a bottom bar on phones): Home, Cards, Pocket, Goals, Activity, Budget or Settings
Hover the family cards to fan them out and tap one to lift it
Tap a kid under Send pocket money, choose an amount and watch the coins fly to their card
On Cards, freeze a card, change limits or block spending categories
Mark chores done, then Approve and pay for a burst of confetti; add to or match savings goals
Edit monthly budget limits, add a kid in Settings, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data
